shortDescription: Manage SyncIQ performance rules on PowerScale Storage System

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: description
options.description: User entered description of the performance rule.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the performance rule is currently in effect during its specified interval. This mandatory while creating/deleting a performance rule.

options.name: limit
options.description: It tells the amount the specified system resource type is limited by this rule. Units are kb/s for bandwidth, files/s for file-count, processing percentage used for cpu, or percentage of maximum available workers. This is a mandatory parameter while creating/deleting a performance rule.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: rule_type
options.description: The type of system resource this rule limits. This is mandatory parameter while creating/deleting a performance rule. This cannot be modified.

options.name: schedule
options.description: A schedule defining when during a week this performance rule is in effect. It is mandatory to enter schedule while creating/deleting a performance rule.

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to determine whether the performance rule exists or not.

options.name: sync_rule_id
options.description: This is an auto generated ID at the time of creation of SyncIQ performance rule. For get/modify/delete operations I(sync_rule_id) is required. The ID of a performance rule is not absolute to a particular existing rule configuration. The IDs are auto-sequenced during creation/deletion of a performance rule.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
